hints.title: Target Node Lookup Collection
hints.text: Convert the list of query nodes into a membership lookup collection for constant-time testing.

hints.title: Postorder Subtree Aggregation
hints.text: If the current node itself is in the query set, return it immediately because no descendant can be an ancestor of this node.

hints.title: Combining Branch Ancestors
hints.text: Recursively search left and right subtrees. If both return non-null, the current node is the common ancestor.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

variables: N: number of nodes in binary tree
complexity.notes: Constructs a hash set in O(M) time and traverses the tree in O(N) time with O(H) recursion depth.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Searching paths for each node independently takes O(M * N) time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Single-pass postorder recursion discovers the common ancestor in optimal linear time.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Generalizing two-node common ancestor to multiple query nodes using set lookup.
